notes.title: Winter Sale with 30% discount!
notes.content: Friends, we are pleased to announce that the game has received a 30% discount. Spend New Year's Eve in the company of five nice girls!

notes.title: German Translation!
notes.content: It is now possible to become the Champion of the Marble Game in German language too!

notes.title: Japanese and Simplified Chinese translations!

Several more translations in progress!
